messages:
Ava: quick check on export modal for vectors. figma: https://figma.com/file/new-export-ui
Ava: key: filename UX, split/parts language, estimated size display, and a11y bits.
Ben - Eng: backend can split at 10k rows/part and gzip each part. We'll stream and produce a zip of parts. Front-end can show preview names.
Clara (PM): product wants default full-text export, but add 'Truncate long fields in export' opt-in. Also default rerank metadata = off for GA.
Jon - A11y: modal must trap focus; announce export progress via aria-live; part preview needs sr-only label. contrast on the part badge should be >=4.5:1. Tooltips must be focusable and closable with ESC.
Rex - Data: include optional rerank columns: rerank_rank, rerank_score, rerank_model. Warn and fail if embedding dims vary across selected rows.
Ava: copy options for header: 1) 'Download embeddings (CSV / JSONL)' 2) 'Export vectors and metadata' — lean 1. Also add small 'How exports work' link.
Clara (PM): pick 1. Show editable filename preview: <dataset>-vectors-<model>-YYYYMMDD.ext and append .partN when split. Allow user edit and live-update preview.
Ben - Eng: client-side estimate: rows * dim * 4 bytes heuristic. Show "Estimated: 10,000 rows ≈ 12 MB (CSV, gzip)". If >100MB require confirmation.
Jon - A11y: ensure estimate updates are read by SR via aria-live; add aria-describedby on limits text.
Ava: final asks before I update figma: header copy (1), editable filename preview + parts, show estimate + per-file limit, aria IDs for limits and progress, tooltips keyboard accessible.
Clara (PM): confirmed. prioritize a11y and split behavior for next sprint.
